defaults.rootCause: Legacy alias or normalized locale URL points to the preferred canonical route.
defaults.correction: Keep one permanent redirect; sitemap and internal links use the destination.

groups.reason: Alternate page with proper canonical tag

defaults.rootCause: Query-state URL or historical service alias consolidates to a canonical page.
defaults.correction: Preserve useful query behavior and canonical consolidation; aliases permanently redirect.

defaults.rootCause: A former templated article was withdrawn because it did not meet the current editorial differentiation standard.
defaults.correction: Added a permanent redirect to the closest current canonical resource.
defaults.remainingAction: Verify production redirect, then allow Google to recrawl.

defaults.rootCause: Cloudflare Email Address Obfuscation rewrote a mail link to its decoding endpoint, which Google crawled as a URL.
defaults.correction: Added a permanent fallback redirect to the contact page.
defaults.remainingAction: Verify the edge passes the direct URL to the application redirect.

defaults.rootCause: Malformed one-character URL discovered historically; no relevant replacement exists.
defaults.correction: Keep a genuine 404 with noindex; do not redirect unrelated URLs.

defaults.rootCause: Aggregate report is stale; live URL Inspection now reports the canonical content URL as indexed.
defaults.correction: No code change required after direct inspection.
defaults.verification: URL Inspection reported indexed on 2026-09-07; crawl allowed, fetch successful, indexing allowed and Google-selected canonical matched.

defaults.rootCause: Manifest and font files are supporting resources, not standalone search documents.
defaults.correction: No change; these resources must remain crawlable for rendering.

defaults.rootCause: Utility route is intentionally available to users but not intended as a search landing page.

defaults.robotsNoindex: robots.txt blocks /search?q=; page metadata is noindex
defaults.rootCause: WebSite SearchAction advertised an internal search URL that is intentionally blocked and noindexed.
defaults.correction: Removed the obsolete SearchAction from WebSite JSON-LD; retained crawl-trap protection.
defaults.remainingAction: Allow the aggregate report to age out; do not request validation because blocking is intentional.

defaults.rootCause: Canonical URL is in the sitemap and linked from its hub, but Google had not crawled it when the report was generated.
defaults.correction: No blanket submission or artificial freshness; prioritize differentiation and crawl demand at cluster level.
defaults.remainingAction: Recheck after sitemap processing; consolidate overlapping warehouse pages only after business approval.
